purpose: Continue two independently seeded heads-up pilots in mixed 1v1/2v2 play to evaluate collaboration with team-trained partners, alongside the main curriculum.
schedule: One hour per seed, sequential; preserve each original run and checkpoint.
independence: These retain distinct initial training seeds and their own optimizer, random states and opponent pools. Neither descends from seed 43 or is trained against the selected candidate.
resume: Use upgrade_run on each original pilots-v2/seed-N directory; run retruco_ml.train --resume from the new source/ml directory with the absolute virtualenv Python and output paths, --hours 1 --players 0 --seed N --workers 4 --environments 32 --device cpu --memory-gib 4 --ipc binary. Resume an interrupted job with only its remaining time budget.
evaluation: Validation seeds only initially; compare team win rates and cross-play with the main candidate. Do not treat one-hour continuations as release evidence or automatically promote any model.
